capability_test: Same exam without vs with AI plus erroneous-AI acceptance
pattern: Large assisted gain with substantial uptake of an incorrect AI answer

capability_test: Unassisted exam after AI-supported practice
pattern: Unrestricted AI raised practice performance but reduced unassisted exam performance; guardrails mitigated harm

capability_test: Knowledge gain and transfer after writing support
pattern: ChatGPT improved essay score but not knowledge gain or transfer relative to alternatives

capability_test: Post-test content mastery after lesson
pattern: Purpose-built AI tutor produced greater immediate learning gains in less time than active-learning classroom

capability_test: Surprise knowledge-retention test at 45 days
pattern: ChatGPT study-aid group showed lower delayed retention than traditional study

capability_test: Posttest and delayed posttest
pattern: Short-term and delayed advantages differed by assistance condition and speech act

capability_test: Retention proxy and performance change after feedback
pattern: Human feedback showed smaller grade decline and higher retention proxy than ChatGPT feedback

capability_test: Correct/incorrect information integration and metacognitive accuracy
pattern: AI increased integration of correct information but did not prevent incorporation of incorrect information

design_setting: First-year medical students; randomized controlled trial
capability_test: Same quiz retaken without resources at one week
pattern: Assisted quiz advantage did not translate into a clear one-week retention advantage

design_setting: Online L2 English; randomized mixed-method study
capability_test: Immediate and delayed posttests
pattern: Teacher-delivered scaffolded feedback outperformed ChatGPT on immediate and delayed learning tests

capability_test: Delayed writing post-test
pattern: AI-supported advantages on several writing measures remained visible at delayed post-test

capability_test: Retention and transfer tests
pattern: Retention comparable but ChatGPT group lower on transfer

capability_test: Independent knowledge-retention test at six weeks
pattern: No immediate group difference; structured ChatGPT-integrated group had higher six-week retention

capability_test: Delayed knowledge retention and clinical-decision outcomes
pattern: Structured GenAI model improved post outcomes and delayed core-concept retention

capability_test: Diagnostic accuracy and confidence under misleading AI
pattern: Misleading AI reduced accuracy and confidence did not reliably calibrate to correctness

capability_test: Supervised independent no-AI near-transfer writing task
pattern: Open AI produced strongest supported writing but bounded support outperformed it on independent higher-order outcomes

design_setting: Math reasoning and reading comprehension; randomized trials
capability_test: Unassisted performance and persistence after assistance
pattern: AI improved short-term performance but reduced later unassisted performance and persistence

design_setting: University lab learning; preregistered randomized experiment
capability_test: Exam without AI plus study behavior
pattern: Near-zero average learning effect with heterogeneity; delegative use associated with worse final-exam performance

design_setting: Undergraduates learning unfamiliar topic; randomized experiment
capability_test: Unaided knowledge tests and essays immediately and at one week
pattern: Positive unaided gains persisted one week especially for augmentation rather than automation use

capability_test: Closed-book monthly and high-stakes exams
pattern: Homework performance/time improved while closed-book exam performance declined especially for outsourcing-style users

capability_test: Post-AI unassisted performance and latent skill change
pattern: More AI requesting predicted worse post-removal performance; independent effort associated with greater skill gain

capability_test: Proctored retention items and proctored vs non-proctored contrast
pattern: Study time fell on AI-susceptible problems and proctored retention odds declined while non-proctored assessment moved oppositely

capability_test: Posttest over seven-week retention period
pattern: Initial AI-supported pretesting gains did not guarantee durable learning; retrieval follow-up outperformed learner-directed AI study
